title: Remote viewing inside a Russian particle beam weapon

tellings.quote: >> But uh what I got was that the uh the particles in the beam are not shooting straight like light does. They swirl as they go.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer in the 1980s, meaning someone trained to perceive hidden targets with the mind, says he was tasked to look inside a Soviet particle beam weapon, a device that fires a stream of tiny particles. According to Buchanan, he saw that the particles in the beam do not travel straight like light but swirl as they go, which if true would mean psychics gathered real military intelligence.
